inferences.text: Celeste appears to be connected to a rehabilitation or redevelopment scheme: the registered land adjoins "Rehab 3 Building" and the promoter's address is in that rehab building. If so, the sale building's completion may depend on the rehab obligations.

steps.text: The record's western boundary is "Adjoining Rehab 3 Building"

inferences.text: Nayan Real Estate looks like one of a pair of Hubtown promoter companies incorporated together, of which only the other is being merged into the listed company. That would leave Celeste's seller outside Hubtown's balance sheet.

steps.text: Nitant Real Estate Private Limited, named by Hubtown as a merging promoter entity, holds CIN U70102MH2010PTC205729
Unverified online reports give Nayan Real Estate's CIN as U70102MH2010PTC205728, the adjacent number (not confirmed by us)
Nayan Real Estate is not named among the merging entities in the part of the FY26 release seen

inferences.text: A company that Hubtown's own release associates with a 72.22% figure, Rare Townships, was ordered by MahaRERA in February 2026 to pay delay interest on a Mumbai project that had no occupation certificate years after its date.

steps.text: MahaRERA partly allowed complaints against Rare Townships Private Limited over a Ghatkopar project due by 31 Dec 2022 with the Covid extension
